content:
Maya: heads-up, the canary started to oscillate again when auto-fallback moved between redwood-16 and redwood-16-quant. end users saw intermittent 502s. proposal: introduce a per-route "stabilizer hold" (anti-flap) that prevents automated fallback decisions for a short, configurable window after a swap. default 30s. avoids churn. any objections?

Kevin: agree, totally needed. design note: do we make it fixed, exponential backoff, or circuit-like (open/half-open)? also need to dedupe flips between the same two model ids vs unrelated swaps.

Tara: console needs to surface this clearly. Suggest a subtle orange pill near the route header: "Stabilizer hold: 00:22" and actions: "Extend hold" / "Force swap (reason required)". also show last 10 fallback events in the route timeline.

Eli: infra-wise we'll add `hold_until` on the decision record + `swap_attempts` counter. Proto knobs: `hold_ms`, `max_attempts_window_ms`, `decay_factor`. Emit events: `stabilizer.hold_started`, `stabilizer.hold_extended`, `stabilizer.force_swap`. include metadata: route, from_model, to_model, cause_metric.

Maya: telemetry: sample detailed KV & request traces during holds at a very low rate (0.5%) to help debug without huge cost. create aggregated metrics: `stabilizer.hold_count`, `stabilizer.active_ratio`, and `stabilizer.flap_rate` per-route.

Kevin: tests: e2e harness that can replay bursts of 5xx/latency and assert we only do one swap per hold window, and that metrics increment. unit tests for half-open window behavior when hold expires.

Tara: microcopy: avoid word "lockout". suggested tooltip: "Temporarily prevents automated model changes after a recent failover to reduce churn and improve stability." For force-swap modal: require a short rationale and include a checkbox to notify on-call.

Eli: API: decision-service should surface `stabilizer_state:{active:true, remaining_ms:22000, cause:"p95_latency"}` so console and dedicated/private planes can show it. Add sandbox toggle `simulate-stabilizer` so PMs/QA can test.

Maya: compliance: audit log all stabilizer events + operator overrides with actor and reason. retention aligns with rollout logs.

deploy-bot: Canary rolling out -> `stabilizer-hold-v1` -> 5% traffic starting 2025-11-12T14:00Z. watch dashboards: `stabilizer.hold_count`, `fallbacks_per_min`, `model_swap_latency`.

Kevin: also propose `sample_during_hold_pct` to allow routing a tiny fraction to the fallback model for human review when semantic-mismatch triggers the hold. config per-route.

Tara: will make UI mock for pill + modal and include a small explain panel "Why is the stabilizer active?" linking to sampled traces and decision trace.

Eli: opened a draft PR with proto snippet: `message Stabilizer { int64 hold_ms = 1; int32 max_swaps = 2; double sample_during_hold_pct = 3; repeated string triggers = 4; }`

Maya: next step: I'll write a short RFC today covering policy schema, console visuals, telemetry, and tests. sync Fri 09:30 infra/design/qa. If no objections I'll start the RFC now."
